text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'm just thinking about what to
send to my
parents next.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Last time I got them tickets to a kabuki
play that
resembled their first meeting...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
And before that, I made some amazake
with my
mother's recipe. At least, I think
that was it...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever. I'll just pick something
that jumps
out at me, like I always do.
